ti.title: ክርስቶስ ሠምራ
ti.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
“ክርስቶስ ሠምራ ረዳኢተይ ኣማላዲተይ
ምሕረት ለምኒ ካብ ኣምላኸይ”`
[[/chorus]]

ብቃል ኪዳንኪ ተማሕጺነ
ስምኪ ጸዊዐ ካብ ሞት ድኂነ
ካብ ሕጂ የለን ሽግር መከራ
ንዓኺ ሒዘ ክርስቶስ ሠምራ

ነፍሰይ ተማሪኻ ብዜና ገድልኺ
ተኣምርኪ ሰሚዓ ኣድኒቓ ክብርኺ
ብሓያል ኪዳንኪ ካብ ሞት ተናግፊ
ንኃጥእ ደጊፍኪ ካብ ሲኦል ተትርፊ
“ክርስቶስ ሠምራ ረዳኢተይ ኣማላዲተይ
ምሕረት ለምኒ ካብ ኣምላኸይ”`

ፍጹም ደምሲስክዮ ናይ ጸላኢ ውዲት
ብጽኑዕ ትሕትና ብስግደት ብጸሎት
ዳግም ምስ ሚካኤል ንሰይጣን ስዒርኪ
ካብ ልዑል ፈጣሪ ኣኽሊል ተቐበልኪ
“ክርስቶስ ሠምራ ረዳኢተይ ኣማላዲተይ
ምሕረት ለምኒ ካብ ኣምላኸይ”

ti_ro.title: Krstos Semra
ti_ro.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
“Krstos semra redaitey amaladitey
Mhret lemni kab amlakhey”`
[[/chorus]]

Bqal kidanki temahtsine
Smki tsewia kab mot dhine
Kab hji yelen shgr mekera
Nakhi hize krstos semra

Nefsey temarikha bzena gedlkhi
Teamrki semia adniqa kbrkhi
Bhayal kidanki kab mot tenagfi
Nhat degifki kab siol tetrfi

Nay mhret lmano meliu lbkhi
Mhret ntselai kab goyta lemenki
Kemzi zlemene ab mela zemena
Keto aysemanan o qdst adena
“Betre maryam redaitey amaladitey
Mhret lemni kab amlakhey”
Ftsum demsiskyo nay tselai wdit
Btsnu thtna bsgdet btselot
Dagm ms mikael nseytan sirki
Kab lul fetari akhlil teqebelki
“Krstos semra redaitey amaladitey
Mhret lemni kab amlakhey”
Menfesawit ade kulu tessmri
Metan keyterfeks ngoyta azekri
Kemtom abotatey nabakhi anqarire
Mhretki tsbe kidanki zekire
“Betre maryam redaitey amaladitey
Mhret lemni kab amlakhey”
